+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_experts,topk", [(31, 6), (1024, 8)])
+def test_routing_map_forward_and_backward_replay(dtype, num_experts, topk):
+    seeded()
+    num_tokens = 4096
+    tokens = torch.arange(num_tokens, device="cuda")
+    slots = torch.arange(topk, device="cuda")
+    route_counts = tokens % (topk + 1)
+    # Distinct, nonconsecutive experts; include empty and partially routed rows.
+    expert_indices = (tokens[:, None] + slots[None, :] * 3) % num_experts
+    valid_routes = slots[None, :] < route_counts[:, None]
+    routing_map = torch.zeros((num_tokens, num_experts), dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+    routing_map.scatter_(1, expert_indices, valid_routes)
+    probs = torch.randn((num_tokens, num_experts), device="cuda", dtype=dtype, requires_grad=True)
+    upstream = torch.randn((num_tokens, topk), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    outputs, gradients = assert_replays_bit_exact(
+        routing_map_to_mok_inputs,
+        (probs, routing_map, topk),
+        grad_outputs={"out[0]": upstream},
+        replays=3,
+        contention=True,
+        what=f"MOK routing map[{dtype}, experts={num_experts}, topk={topk}]",
+    )
+
+    expected_indices = expert_indices.masked_fill(~valid_routes, num_experts).sort(dim=1).values
+    expected_valid = expected_indices < num_experts
+    safe_indices = expected_indices.clamp_max(num_experts - 1)
+    expected_weights = probs.detach().float().gather(1, safe_indices)
+    expected_weights.masked_fill_(~expected_valid, 0.0)
+    expected_grad = torch.zeros_like(probs)
+    rows = tokens[:, None].expand_as(expected_indices)
+    expected_grad[rows[expected_valid], expected_indices[expected_valid]] = upstream[
+        expected_valid
+    ].to(dtype)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        outputs["out[1]"], expected_indices.masked_fill(~expected_valid, -1).int(), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(outputs["out[0]"], expected_weights, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(gradients["in[0]"], expected_grad, rtol=0, atol=0)

+    pytest.importorskip('emerging_optimizers.orthogonalized_optimizers.sinkhorn_utils')
+    if communication_backend == 'symmetric':
+        pytest.importorskip('nccl.core.device.cute', exc_type=ImportError)

+        pytest.skip('requires EP2 and at least two expert-DP replicas')
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel(expert_model_parallel_size=2)
+    runtime = None
+    try:
+        torch.manual_seed(123)
+        pg = ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups()
+        config = TransformerConfig(
+            num_layers=2,
+            hidden_size=64,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            bf16=True,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            use_cpu_initialization=False,
+            gradient_accumulation_fusion=False,
+            fp8='e4m3',
+            fp8_recipe=Fp8Recipe.mxfp8,
+            fp8_param=True,
+        )
+        # These row counts produce different physical shard sizes on the two EP ranks.
+        model = EPShardedMultiTableEmbedding(
+            config,
+            (129, 65),
+            32,
+            config.init_method,
+            pg.ep,
+            pg.tp,
+            pg.expt_dp,
+            fp8_storage=True,
+            communication_backend=communication_backend,
+        ).cuda()
+        convert_module_to_dtype_except_fp32_marked(model, torch.bfloat16)
+        weights = [table.weight for table in model.tables]
+        for weight in weights:
+            assert weight.row_shard_group is pg.ep and not weight.allreduce
+            weight.lr_mult = 5.0
+        if communication_backend == 'symmetric':
+            # Keep real TE tensors/quantization, but force unaligned allocator
+            # suballocations for both bytes and scales before optimizer/DDP setup.
+            for weight in weights:
+                for name in ('_rowwise_data', '_rowwise_scale_inv'):
+                    original = getattr(weight, name)
+                    parent = torch.empty(original.numel() + 4096, dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
+                    start = (512 - parent.data_ptr()) % 4096
+                    replacement = torch.from_dlpack(parent[start : start + original.numel()])
+                    replacement = replacement.view_as(original)
+                    replacement.copy_(original)
+                    setattr(weight, name, replacement)
+                    assert replacement.untyped_storage().data_ptr() % 4096 == 512
+            runtime = embedding_impl.EngramRuntime(8, defer_grad_transfer=True)
+            runtime.attach(model)
+        tag_params_for_buffer_routing([model], use_sinkhorn_for_embeddings=True)
+        optimizer_config = OptimizerConfig(
+            optimizer='muon',
+            bf16=True,
+            lr=0.02,
+            clip_grad=0.0,
+            muon_use_sinkhorn=True,
+            use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+            use_layer_wise_param_layout=use_layout,
+        )
+        overrides = get_standard_config_overrides(optimizer_config)
+        overrides.update(_muon_param_overrides_factory())
+        groups = _get_param_groups([model], optimizer_config, overrides)
+        assert all(group['optimizer'] == 'sinkhorn' for group in groups if group['params'])
+        assert all(group['lr_mult'] == 5.0 for group in groups if group['params'])
+        ddp = DistributedDataParallel(
+            config,
+            DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+                grad_reduce_in_fp32=True,
+                overlap_grad_reduce=True,
+                overlap_param_gather=True,
+                use_distributed_optimizer=True,
+                use_layer_wise_param_layout=use_layout,
+                fp8_param_gather=True,
+                reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag=True,
+            ),
+            model,
+            pg_collection=pg,
+        )
+        assert not ddp.buffers and ddp.expert_parallel_buffers
+        optimizer = LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer(
+            [Sinkhorn([{'params': weights, 'is_expert_parallel': True}], lr=0.02)],
+            optimizer_config,
+            pg_collection=pg,
+            model_chunks=[ddp],
+        )
+        child = optimizer.chained_optimizers[0]
+        masters = {
+            id(weight): master
+            for model_group, master_group in zip(
+                child.float16_groups, child.fp32_from_float16_groups
+            )
+            for weight, master in zip(model_group, master_group)
+        }
+        rows = torch.arange(129, device='cuda')
+        hashes = torch.stack((rows, rows % 65), dim=-1)
+        previous = None
+        for _ in range(3):
+            ddp.zero_grad_buffer()
+            optimizer.zero_grad()
+            if runtime is not None:
+                runtime.reset()
+            optimizer.prepare_model_params_for_param_sync()
+            references = []
+            for index, table in enumerate(model.tables):
+                expected_shard = torch.zeros(
+                    table.weight.shape, device='cuda', dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+                if id(table.weight) in masters:
+                    expected_shard.copy_(masters[id(table.weight)].detach())
+                dist.broadcast(
+                    expected_shard, dist.get_global_rank(pg.expt_dp, index), group=pg.expt_dp
+                )
+                expected_shard = embedding_impl._mxfp8_quantizer()(expected_shard).dequantize()
+                reference = torch.zeros(
+                    table.global_num_embeddings, 32, device='cuda', dtype=torch.bfloat16
+                )
+                reference[table.row_start : table.row_end] = expected_shard[
+                    : table.local_num_embeddings
+                ]
+                dist.all_reduce(reference, group=pg.ep)
+                references.append(reference[hashes[:, index]])
+            # Engram's FP8 path never calls table.forward(), where DDP installs its hooks.
+            activation = (
+                runtime.consume(runtime.prefetch(model, hashes), 64)
+                if runtime is not None
+                else model.lookup_quantized(hashes, 64)

+            expected = torch.cat(references, dim=-1)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            if previous is not None:
+                assert not torch.equal(actual, previous)
+            previous = actual.detach().clone()
+            actual.float().square().sum().backward()
+            ddp.finish_grad_sync()
+            assert not optimizer.prepare_grads()
+            assert optimizer.step_with_ready_grads()
+            assert all(weight._columnwise_data is None for weight in weights)
+    finally:
+        if runtime is not None:
+            runtime.close()
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()

+def _sinkhorn_distributed_worker(rank, path, use_layout, padded):
+    """Compare EP2 x replica-DP2 updates/resume with complete-matrix EO updates."""
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        'gloo', init_method='file://' + path, rank=rank, world_size=4, timeout=timedelta(seconds=60)
+    )
+    ep_groups = [dist.new_group(ranks) for ranks in ([0, 1], [2, 3])]
+    replica_groups = [dist.new_group(ranks) for ranks in ([0, 2], [1, 3])]
+    ep = ep_groups[rank // 2]
+    replica = replica_groups[rank % 2]
+    try:
+        torch.manual_seed(109)
+        model = EPShardedMultiTableEmbedding(
+            _config(), (17, 19), 5, _config().init_method, ep, expt_dp_group=replica
+        )
+        if padded:
+            for table in model.tables:
+                table.weight.data = torch.nn.functional.pad(table.weight.data, (0, 0, 0, 7))
+        # Different local sizes deliberately perturb ordinary bin packing across EP peers.
+        model.extra = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(8 if rank % 2 == 0 else 11, 5))
+        model.extra.allreduce = False
+        tag_params_for_buffer_routing([model], use_sinkhorn_for_embeddings=True)
+        full_weights = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.randn(rows, 5)) for rows in (17, 19)]
+        references = [Sinkhorn([param], lr=0.02) for param in full_weights]
+        for table, full in zip(model.tables, full_weights):
+            table.weight.data[: table.local_num_embeddings].copy_(
+                full[table.row_start : table.row_end]
+            )
+        optimizer = Sinkhorn(
+            [{'params': [t.weight for t in model.tables], 'is_expert_parallel': True}], lr=0.02
+        )
+        extra_optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(
+            [{'params': [model.extra], 'is_expert_parallel': True}], lr=0.02
+        )
+        owner = object.__new__(LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)
+        owner.dp_cp, owner.expt_dp = dist.group.WORLD, replica
+        layouts = None
+        if use_layout:
+            layout = owner._compute_per_buffer_param_layout(
+                list(model.parameters()),
+                50,
+                2,
+                SimpleNamespace(pad_buckets_for_high_nccl_busbw=False),
+            )
+            layouts = [
+                FullParamLayout({BufferKey(torch.float32, torch.float32, True, True): layout})
+            ]
+        owner.shard_params([optimizer, extra_optimizer], layouts)
+        local_params = optimizer.param_groups[0]['params']
+        assert len(local_params) == 1
+        assert local_params[0] is model.tables[replica.rank()].weight
+        restored = None
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(311)
+        for iteration in range(5):
+            gradients = [torch.randn(p.shape, generator=generator) for p in full_weights]
+            for table, grad, reference in zip(model.tables, gradients, references):
+                grad[: table.global_num_embeddings // 2] *= torch.tensor([100, 1, 0.1, 0.01, 2])
+                grad[0].zero_()
+                grad[1].mul_(1e-7)
+                if iteration == 1:
+                    # A missing local gradient must still update old momentum globally.
+                    grad[(table.global_num_embeddings + 1) // 2 :].zero_()
+                absent = iteration == 3 or (iteration == 1 and ep.rank() == 1)
+                local_grad = torch.zeros_like(table.weight)
+                local_grad[: table.local_num_embeddings].copy_(
+                    grad[table.row_start : table.row_end]
+                )
+                table.weight.grad = None if absent else local_grad
+                reference.param_groups[0]['params'][0].grad = None if iteration == 3 else grad
+                reference.step()
+            optimizer.step()
+            if restored is not None:
+                for actual, resumed in zip(local_params, restored.param_groups[0]['params']):
+                    resumed.grad = None if actual.grad is None else actual.grad.clone()
+                restored.step()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    restored.param_groups[0]['params'][0], local_params[0], rtol=0, atol=0
+                )

+def _fp8_wire_worker(rank, path, num_tables, ep_size):
+    """Real byte AllToAll/autograd, with only TE's GEMM-input wrapper replaced on CPU."""
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        'gloo', init_method='file://' + path, rank=rank, world_size=2, timeout=timedelta(seconds=60)
+    )
+    try:
+        config = _config()
+        model = EPShardedMultiTableEmbedding(
+            config,
+            (97, 101)[:num_tables],
+            64,
+            config.init_method,
+            ep_group=dist.group.WORLD if ep_size > 1 else None,
+        )
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(918)
+        reference_weights = []
+        for table in model.tables:
+            data = torch.randn(table.global_num_embeddings, 64, generator=generator).to(
+                torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            )
+            scales = torch.randint(
+                123, 132, (table.global_num_embeddings, 2), generator=generator, dtype=torch.uint8
+            )
+            values = data.float().view(-1, 2, 32) * torch.exp2(scales.float() - 127).unsqueeze(-1)
+            reference_weights.append(values.flatten(-2).requires_grad_())
+            table.weight._rowwise_data = data.view(torch.uint8)[table.row_start : table.row_end]
+            table.weight._rowwise_scale_inv = scales[table.row_start : table.row_end]
+
+        def cpu_activation(packed, embedding_dim, output_width, dtype, needs_wgrad, order=None):
+            assert packed.dtype == torch.uint8
+            assert packed.shape[1] == embedding_dim + embedding_dim // 32
+            if order is not None:
+                ordered = torch.empty_like(packed)
+                ordered.index_copy_(0, order, packed)
+                packed = ordered
+            values = packed[:, :embedding_dim].contiguous().view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()
+            scales = torch.exp2(packed[:, embedding_dim:].float() - 127)
+            values = (values.view(-1, embedding_dim // 32, 32) * scales.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+            tokens = values.numel() // output_width
+            values = values.view(tokens, output_width)
+            return torch.nn.functional.pad(
+                values, (0, 0, 0, max(32, (tokens + 31) // 32 * 32) - tokens)
+            )
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(embedding_impl, 'is_mxfp8tensor', lambda p: hasattr(p, '_rowwise_data')),
+            patch.object(embedding_impl, '_mxfp8_lookup_activation', cpu_activation),
+        ):
+            for empty_requester in (False, True):
+                tokens = 0 if empty_requester and rank == 0 else 3 + rank
+                ids = torch.randint(0, 97, (tokens, 3, num_tables), generator=generator)
+                if tokens:
+                    ids[0] = 0  # duplicate rows in multiple heads
+                output = model.lookup_quantized(ids, 3 * num_tables * 64)
+                expected = torch.stack(
+                    [
+                        torch.nn.functional.embedding(ids[..., index], weight)
+                        for index, weight in enumerate(reference_weights)
+                    ],
+                    dim=-2,
+                ).reshape(tokens, 3 * num_tables * 64)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(output[:tokens], expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+                assert torch.count_nonzero(output[tokens:]) == 0
+                gradient = torch.randn(expected.shape, generator=generator)
+                (expected * gradient).sum().backward()
+                (output[:tokens] * gradient).sum().backward()
+                for table, reference in zip(model.tables, reference_weights):
+                    if ep_size > 1:
+                        dist.all_reduce(reference.grad)
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        table.weight.grad,
+                        reference.grad[table.row_start : table.row_end],
+                        rtol=1e-6,
+                        atol=1e-6,
+                    )
+                    table.weight.grad = None
+                    reference.grad = None
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()

+def test_hybridep_engram_interleaved_plan(size, pattern):
+    """Exact per-round capacities agree with independently enumerated routed rows."""
+    counts = (torch.arange(size * size, device="cpu").reshape(size, size) * 37 + 17) % 133
+    if pattern == "uniform":
+        counts.fill_(128)
+    elif pattern == "hotspot":
+        counts.zero_()
+        counts[:, 0] = 131 + torch.arange(size, device="cpu")
+    elif pattern == "empty_requester":
+        counts[0].zero_()
+    elif pattern in ("empty", "tiny"):
+        counts.zero_()
+        if pattern == "tiny":
+            counts[0, -1] = 1
+    transport = embedding_impl._EngramAllToAll(None, "hybridep", 64)
+    for matrix in (counts, counts.T):
+        destinations = [
+            [peer for peer, count in enumerate(row) for _ in range(count)]
+            for row in matrix.tolist()
+        ]
+        max_rows = max(map(len, destinations))
+        rounds = (max_rows + 63) // 64
+        expected = [[0] * size for _ in range(rounds)]
+        for rows in destinations:
+            for round_id in range(rounds):
+                targets = rows[round_id::rounds]
+                assert len(targets) <= 64
+                for peer in targets:
+                    expected[round_id][peer] += 1
+        for rank in range(size):
+            with patch.object(transport, "rank", rank):
+                plan = transport._hybridep_plan(matrix)
+            assert plan.max_rows == max_rows
+            assert plan.recv_rows == tuple(row[rank] for row in expected)
+            assert sum(plan.recv_rows) == int(matrix[:, rank].sum())
+            if pattern == "uniform":
+                # Every rank receives work in every round, without a first-round hotspot.
+                assert set(plan.recv_rows) == {64}

+    reference = embedding_impl._EngramAllToAll(group)

+        splits = [chunk_size + 1 + (rank + peer) % 3 for peer in range(size)]
+        if pattern == "hotspot":
+            splits = [2 * chunk_size + 1 + rank] + [0] * (size - 1)
+        if pattern == "empty" or (pattern == "empty_requester" and rank == 0):
+            splits = [0] * size
+        # Two tables per peer ensure the count transpose preserves both axes.
+        counts = torch.tensor([[n // 2, n - n // 2] for n in splits], device="cuda").flatten()
+        sent, recv_splits, table_counts, _ = reference.exchange_counts(counts)
+        assert sent == splits
+        elements = torch.arange(sum(splits) * width, device="cuda").reshape(sum(splits), width)
+        if dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+            # Covers every 16-bit pattern, including NaNs/subnormals/signed zero.
+            payload = (elements + rank).to(torch.int16).view(torch.bfloat16)
+        elif dtype == torch.int64:
+            payload = elements + (1 << 50) + rank * (1 << 40)
+        else:
+            payload = elements.to(dtype)
+        expected = reference.exchange(payload, recv_splits, splits)
+        with patch.object(dist, "all_to_all_single", side_effect=AssertionError("NCCL A2A used")):
+            actual_sent, actual_recv, actual_tables, plans = transport.exchange_counts(counts)
+            assert (actual_sent, actual_recv, actual_tables) == (splits, recv_splits, table_counts)
+            actual = transport.exchange(payload, recv_splits, splits, plans[0])
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                actual.view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8), rtol=0, atol=0
+            )
+            # Replaying a planned exchange must not synchronize max_rows again.
+            with (
+                patch.object(dist, "all_reduce", side_effect=AssertionError("max_rows all-reduce")),
+                patch.object(

+            for call, expected_rows in zip(dispatch.call_args_list, plans[0].recv_rows):

+            restored = transport.exchange(actual, splits, recv_splits, plans[1])

+        outputs = []
+        for model in models:
+            model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            context = patch.object(
+                dist, "all_to_all_single", side_effect=AssertionError("NCCL A2A used")
+            )
+            # The reference must still exercise real NCCL A2A.
+            if model is models[0]:
+                context = nullcontext()
+            with context:
+                results, losses = [], []
+                for lookup_ids, lookup_grad in ((ids, gradient), (ids.flip(0)[::2], gradient[::2])):
+                    count = lookup_ids.shape[0]

+class _ReferenceDeviceTransport:
+    """CPU reference for the runtime's local-request/ID-plus-gradient contract."""
+
+    def __init__(self, group):
+        self.group = group
+
+    def exchange(self, source, recv, send, plan, workspace_bytes):
+        output = source.new_empty((sum(recv), *source.shape[1:]))
+        dist.all_to_all_single(output, source.contiguous(), recv, send, group=self.group)
+        return output
+
+    def lookup(self, key, data, scales, requests, send, recv, plans, workspace_bytes):
+        assert not scales
+        received = self.exchange(requests, recv, send, plans[0], workspace_bytes)
+        result = data[0].new_empty((sum(recv), data[0].shape[1]))
+        for table, weight in enumerate(data):
+            mask = received[:, 0] == table
+            result[mask] = weight[received[mask, 1]]
+        return self.exchange(result, send, recv, plans[1], workspace_bytes).view(torch.uint8)
+
+    def close(self):
+        pass
+

+        with patch.object(
+            embedding_impl,
+            'require',
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(EngramDeviceTransport=_ReferenceDeviceTransport),
+        ):
+            model = EPShardedMultiTableEmbedding(
+                _config(),
+                (7, 2),
+                4,
+                _config().init_method,
+                ep_group=dist.group.WORLD,
+                communication_backend='symmetric',
+            )
+        reference = [torch.arange(size * 4).reshape(size, 4).float() / 13 for size in (7, 2)]
+        for table, full in zip(model.tables, reference):
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                table.weight.copy_(full[table.row_start : table.row_end])
+        runtime = embedding_impl.EngramRuntime(1, defer_grad_transfer=defer)
+        runtime.attach(model)
+        tickets, expected, gradients = [], [], []
+        full_grad = [torch.zeros_like(full) for full in reference]
+        for step in range(3):
+            # Rank 0 asks for no rows; the smaller table has two empty owners.
+            rows = torch.arange(0 if rank == 0 else 11 + rank)
+            ids = torch.stack(((rows + step) % 7, rows % 2), dim=-1)
+            ticket = runtime.prefetch(model, ids)
+            assert ticket.requests.shape[0] == sum(ticket.send_splits)
+            tickets.append(ticket)
+            expected.append(torch.stack([full[ids[:, i]] for i, full in enumerate(reference)], 1))
+            grad = torch.arange(ids.numel() * 4).reshape(*ids.shape, 4).float() / 31
+            gradients.append(grad)
+            for i in range(2):
+                full_grad[i].index_add_(0, ids[:, i], grad[:, i])
+        for step in (1, 0, 2):
+            output = runtime.consume(tickets[step])
+            torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected[step], rtol=0, atol=0)
+            output.backward(gradients[step])
+        runtime.finish_deferred_gradients()
+        for table, full in zip(model.tables, full_grad):
+            dist.all_reduce(full)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(table.weight.grad, full[table.row_start : table.row_end])
+        runtime.close()
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('layout', ['extra', 'reordered', 'frozen', 'failure'])
+def test_shared_graph_preserves_output_slots_with_legacy_te_buffer_reuse(monkeypatch, layout):
+    """Exercise capture_many/run with TE's old cache key and real CPU autograd."""
+    keys = ['ids', 'grad_a', 'readonly', 'grad_b', 'counts', 'candidates']
+    other_keys = keys.copy()
+    if layout == 'reordered':
+        other_keys[0], other_keys[1] = other_keys[1], other_keys[0]
+    else:
+        other_keys.insert(4, 'extra_ids')
+
+    class Region(nn.Module):
+        def __init__(self, names):
+            super().__init__()
+            self.names = names
+            self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.75))
+
+        def forward(self, hidden, state):
+            output = hidden * self.weight
+            values = {}
+            for name in self.names:
+                if name.startswith('grad_'):
+                    value = output * (2 if name == 'grad_a' else 3)
+                    if layout == 'frozen' and name == 'grad_b':
+                        value = value.detach()
+                elif name == 'readonly' and layout == 'frozen':
+                    value = hidden.detach() + 17
+                else:
+                    value = torch.arange(hidden.numel(), device=hidden.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+                values[name] = value
+            return output, values
+
+    def region(names):
+        fields = tuple(
+            TensorField(
+                name,
+                (4,),
+                (
+                    torch.float32
+                    if name.startswith('grad_') or (name == 'readonly' and layout == 'frozen')
+                    else torch.int32
+                ),
+                'contiguous',
+                name.startswith('grad_'),
+            )
+            for name in names
+        )
+        return StatefulModule(Region(names), output_fields=fields)
+
+    regions = [region(names) for names in (other_keys, keys)]
+    references = copy.deepcopy(regions)
+    sample = torch.ones(4, requires_grad=True)
+    cache_entries = []
+    original_calls = {}
+
+    class LegacyTEReplay(torch.autograd.Function):
+        @staticmethod
+        def forward(ctx, grad_slots, *outputs):
+            ctx.grad_slots = grad_slots
+            ctx.active = tuple(t is not None and t.requires_grad for t in outputs)
+            return tuple(t.detach() if t is not None else None for t in outputs)
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def backward(ctx, *grads):
+            if len(grads) != len(ctx.grad_slots):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f'Backward graph grad dimension mismatch: received {len(grads)} grads, '
+                    f'but expected {len(ctx.grad_slots)} static_grad_outputs'
+                )
+            if ctx.active != ctx.grad_slots:
+                raise ValueError('Backward graph gradient slot positions mismatch')
+            return (None, *grads)
+
+    def capture(wrappers, args, **kwargs):
+        assert kwargs['_reuse_graph_input_output_buffers'] is True
+        if layout == 'failure':
+            # TE temporarily replaces the capture module class's __call__.
+            # An exception must not leave that replacement installed.
+            cls = type(wrappers[0])
+            original_calls[cls] = cls.__dict__.get('__call__')
+            cls.__call__ = lambda *a, **kw: None
+            raise RuntimeError('intentional shared capture failure')
+        outputs = [wrapper(*inputs) for wrapper, inputs in zip(wrappers, args)]
+        cache, slots = {}, [None] * len(wrappers)
+        # TE captures each chunk's backwards in reverse layer order. Its old
+        # key drops nondifferentiable slots; the cached value retains them.
+        for i in reversed(range(len(wrappers))):
+            key = tuple(
+                (t.shape, t.dtype, t.layout)
+                for t in outputs[i]
+                if t is not None and t.requires_grad
+            )
+            slots[i] = cache.setdefault(
+                key, tuple(t is not None and t.requires_grad for t in outputs[i])
+            )
+        cache_entries.append(len(cache))
+        return [
+            lambda *inputs, wrapper=wrapper, slots=slots, **kw: LegacyTEReplay.apply(
+                slots, *wrapper(*inputs)
+            )
+            for wrapper, slots in zip(wrappers, slots)
+        ]
+
+    te = ModuleType('transformer_engine')
+    te.pytorch = ModuleType('transformer_engine.pytorch')
+    te.pytorch.graph = SimpleNamespace(
+        is_graph_capturing=lambda: False, set_capture_end=lambda: None
+    )
+    te.pytorch.make_graphed_callables = capture
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, 'transformer_engine', te)
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, 'transformer_engine.pytorch', te.pytorch)
+
+    def cpu_owner(self, region, hidden, state, *, slots, backend, **kwargs):
+        assert kwargs['_defer_capture']
+        self.region, self.device, self._backend = region, hidden.device, backend
+        self._output_wrapper = None
+        self.debug_checks = False
+        self._signature = (self._tensor_signature(hidden),)
+        self._busy, self._generation, self._recorded = [False] * slots, [0] * slots, [False] * slots
+        self._wrappers, self._manual_forward_hooks = [], []
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(StatefulGraphs, '__init__', cpu_owner)
+    if layout == 'failure':
+        try:
+            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='intentional shared capture failure'):
+                StatefulGraphs.capture_many(
+                    [(module, sample, {}, None) for module in regions],
+                    order=[1, -1],
+                    num_layers_per_chunk=[2],
+                )
+            for cls, original in original_calls.items():
+                assert cls.__dict__.get('__call__') is original
+        finally:
+            for cls, original in original_calls.items():
+                if original is None:
+                    if '__call__' in cls.__dict__:
+                        delattr(cls, '__call__')
+                else:
+                    cls.__call__ = original
+        return
+    owners = StatefulGraphs.capture_many(
+        [(module, sample, {}, None) for module in regions], order=[1, -1], num_layers_per_chunk=[2]
+    )
+    assert cache_entries == [1], 'Compatible gradient buffers must still be shared'
+    for owner in owners:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            owner, '_release', lambda slot, owner=owner: owner._busy.__setitem__(slot, False)
+        )
+    for _ in range(2):
+        for owner, reference in zip(owners, references):
+            owner.region.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            reference.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            x = torch.randn(4, requires_grad=True)
+            y = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
+            actual, state = owner.run(x, {})
+            expected, ref_state = reference.run(y, {})
+            assert tuple(state) == tuple(ref_state)
+            for key in state:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(state[key], ref_state[key])
+                assert state[key].requires_grad == ref_state[key].requires_grad
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+            (actual.sum() + state['grad_a'].sum() + state['grad_b'].sum()).backward()
+            (expected.sum() + ref_state['grad_a'].sum() + ref_state['grad_b'].sum()).backward()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(x.grad, y.grad)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                owner.region.module.weight.grad, reference.module.weight.grad
+            )
+
+
+def test_between_step_capture_discards_gradients_without_main_grad_backups(monkeypatch):
+    """A completed-step capture must not duplicate model-sized FP32 grad buffers."""
+    module = nn.Linear(4, 4, bias=False)
+    module.register_buffer('calls', torch.tensor(17))
+    parameter = module.weight
+    parameter.main_grad = torch.ones_like(parameter)
+    parameter.grad = torch.full_like(parameter, 3)
+    previous_grad = parameter.grad
+    clone = torch.Tensor.clone
+
+    def reject_main_grad_copy(tensor, *args, **kwargs):
+        assert tensor is not parameter.main_grad, 'Completed-step main_grad must not be backed up'
+        return clone(tensor, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.Tensor, 'clone', reject_main_grad_copy)
+    owner = object.__new__(StatefulGraphs)
+    owner.region = module
+    with owner._capture_grad_state(None, preserve_gradients=False):
+        parameter.main_grad.add_(7)
+        module.calls.add_(3)
+    assert parameter.grad is previous_grad
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(parameter.main_grad) == 0
+    assert module.calls.item() == 17
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('counts,order', [([3], [1, -1]), ([1, 1], [1, 1, 2, -1, 2, -1, -2, -2])])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('clone_inputs', [False, True])
+def test_scheduled_static_inputs_survive_all_outstanding_forwards(counts, order, clone_inputs):
+    """Overwrite each incoming microbatch to detect any premature buffer reuse."""
+    samples = [(torch.zeros(4, 8, requires_grad=True),) for _ in range(sum(counts))]
+    args = StatefulGraphs._scheduled_sample_args(samples, order, counts, clone_inputs=clone_inputs)
+    source_pointers = {sample[0].data_ptr() for sample in samples}
+    captured_pointers = {sample[0].data_ptr() for sample in args}
+    assert bool(source_pointers & captured_pointers) is not clone_inputs
+    microbatches = len(order) // (2 * len(counts))
+    offsets = [sum(counts[:i]) for i in range(len(counts))]
+    forward_index = [0] * len(counts)
+    pending = [[] for _ in counts]
+    live_pointers, all_pointers = set(), set()
+    max_live = 0
+    for event, operation in enumerate(order):
+        chunk = abs(operation) - 1
+        if operation > 0:
+            current = []
+            for layer in range(counts[chunk]):
+                index = offsets[chunk] * microbatches + forward_index[chunk] * counts[chunk] + layer
+                tensor = args[index][0]
+                pointer = tensor.data_ptr()
+                assert pointer not in live_pointers
+                with torch.no_grad():
+                    tensor.fill_(event)
+                current.append((tensor, event))
+                live_pointers.add(pointer)
+                all_pointers.add(pointer)
+            pending[chunk].append(current)
+            forward_index[chunk] += 1
+            max_live = max(max_live, len(live_pointers))
+        else:
+            for tensor, expected in pending[chunk].pop(0):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(tensor, torch.full_like(tensor, expected))
+                live_pointers.remove(tensor.data_ptr())
+    assert not live_pointers
+    assert len(all_pointers) == max_live
+

+def test_engram_window_range_includes_unaligned_storage(monkeypatch, storage_offset, view_offset):
+    """Storage and tensor offsets both contribute to the registered window offset."""
+    pytest.importorskip("nccl.core.device.cute", exc_type=ImportError)
+    from megatron.core.ops import engram
+
+    base, size = 0x10000, 16384
+    address = base + storage_offset
+    storage = SimpleNamespace(data_ptr=lambda: address, nbytes=lambda: size)
+    tensor = SimpleNamespace(
+        untyped_storage=lambda: storage,
+        data_ptr=lambda: address + view_offset,
+        stride=lambda dim: 32,
+        element_size=lambda: 1,
+        device=torch.device("cuda"),
+    )
+    # The storage extends beyond its first mapping, as with expandable segments.
+    query = Mock(return_value=(engram.cuda.CUresult.CUDA_SUCCESS, base, 8192))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(engram.cuda, "cuMemGetAddressRange", query)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "device", lambda device: nullcontext())
+    make_buffer = Mock(
+        side_effect=lambda ptr, size, owner: SimpleNamespace(handle=ptr, size=size, owner=owner)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(engram, "Buffer", SimpleNamespace(from_handle=make_buffer))
+
+    buffer, offset, stride = engram.EngramDeviceTransport._storage_view(tensor)
+    query.assert_called_once_with(address)
+    # A rounded suballocation would register successfully, but NCCL LSA reads
+    # would use this rank's window offset on peers with different suballocations.
+    assert buffer.handle == base

+    assert buffer.handle + offset == tensor.data_ptr()

+def test_engram_table_window_refresh_is_collective(monkeypatch, change):
+    """A change on one shard refreshes all windows and remote view metadata."""
+    pytest.importorskip("nccl.core.device.cute", exc_type=ImportError)
+    from megatron.core.ops.engram import EngramDeviceTransport
+
+    transport = EngramDeviceTransport.__new__(EngramDeviceTransport)
+    transport.group, transport.size, transport.tables = object(), 2, {}
+    transport.barrier = Mock()
+    windows = []
+
+    def register(view):
+        window = SimpleNamespace(is_valid=True, close=Mock())
+        windows.append(window)
+        return window
+
+    transport.comm = SimpleNamespace(register_window=register)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "current_stream", lambda: SimpleNamespace(synchronize=Mock()))
+    # Mock only CUDA allocation discovery; retain real storage lifetime/signatures.
+    describe = Mock(
+        side_effect=lambda tensor: (
+            SimpleNamespace(owner=tensor.untyped_storage()),
+            tensor.storage_offset() * tensor.element_size(),
+            tensor.stride(0) * tensor.element_size(),
+        )
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(transport, "_storage_view", describe)
+    remote_changed = False
+
+    def gather(result, info, group):
+        assert group is transport.group
+        result[0] = info
+        # Exercise an unaligned remote view, even when this rank's view is aligned.
+        result[1] = (remote_changed, [(2 if remote_changed else 0, 32)], None)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dist, "all_gather_object", gather)
+    data = [torch.zeros(3, 8)]
+    key = object()
+    first, _, aligned = transport._register_tables(key, data, [])
+    assert aligned
+    old_pointer = data[0].untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+    assert transport.tables[key][2][0][0].owner.data_ptr() == old_pointer
+    if change == "local":
+        data[0] = data[0].clone()
+    remote_changed = change == "remote"
+    second, metadata, aligned = transport._register_tables(key, data, [])
+    assert len(windows) == (1 if change == "none" else 2)
+    assert first[0].close.call_count == (change != "none")
+    assert (second is first) == (change == "none")
+    assert aligned == (change != "remote")
+    assert metadata[0, 1, 0] == (2 if remote_changed else 0)
+    assert describe.call_count == (2 if change == "local" else 1)

+    update[row_norms.squeeze(1) <= threshold * row_norms.mean()] = 0

+        dim = 1 if step % 2 == 0 else 0
+        update = update / (update.norm(dim=dim, keepdim=True) + eps)

+def test_layerwise_sinkhorn_checkpoint_containers(as_dict, empty_sinkhorn_owner):
+    """Restore multi-child LayerWise checkpoints, including a rank owning no embedding."""
+    pytest.importorskip('emerging_optimizers.orthogonalized_optimizers.sinkhorn_utils')
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer import LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.optimizer import ChainedOptimizer
+
+    def build(params):
+        # Isolate checkpoint serialization from CUDA/DDP setup. These are the local,
+        # already-sharded optimizers; distributed ownership is tested separately.
+        children = [
+            TensorParallelMuon([params[0]], fp32_matmul_prec='highest'),
+            eo_mod.Sinkhorn([{'params': [] if empty_sinkhorn_owner else [params[1]]}]),
+        ]
+        chain = object.__new__(LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)
+        ChainedOptimizer.__init__(chain, children)
+        return chain
+
+    torch.manual_seed(199)
+    params = [nn.Parameter(torch.randn(8, 4)) for _ in range(2)]
+    original = build(params)
+    for param in params:
+        param.grad = torch.randn_like(param)
+    for child in original.chained_optimizers:
+        child.step()
+    checkpoint = copy.deepcopy(original.state_dict())
+    assert isinstance(checkpoint, list)
+    restored_params = [nn.Parameter(p.detach().clone()) for p in params]
+    restored = build(restored_params)
+    restored.load_state_dict(dict(enumerate(checkpoint)) if as_dict else checkpoint)
+    for param, restored_param in zip(params, restored_params):
+        param.grad = torch.randn_like(param)
+        restored_param.grad = param.grad.clone()
+    for chain in (original, restored):
+        for child in chain.chained_optimizers:
+            child.step()
+    for param, restored_param in zip(params, restored_params):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(param, restored_param, atol=0, rtol=0)

+    monkeypatch.setattr(eo_mod, 'newton_schulz_tp', lambda *args, **kwargs: outputs)
+    optimizer = TensorParallelMuon(

+    )
+    actual = optimizer.scaled_orthogonalize_fn(outputs, tp_group=None)
+    expected = F.normalize(direction.double().flatten(), dim=0, eps=0).view(3, 5)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('splits', [[3, 3, 3], [2, 3, 4]])
+def test_muon_rms_per_head_step_and_resume(splits):
+    """Optimizer steps use RMS per head, preserve zero updates/decay, and resume exactly."""
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42)
+    param = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(sum(splits), 7, generator=generator))
+    param.qkv_split_shapes_global = splits
+    kwargs = dict(
+        lr=0.02,
+        weight_decay=0.1,
+        momentum=0.95,
+        nesterov=True,
+        split_qkv=True,
+        split_qkv_per_head=True,
+        is_qkv_fn=lambda p: True,
+        scale_mode='rms',
+        extra_scale_factor=0.18,
+        coefficient_type='deepseekv4',
+        num_ns_steps=10,
+        fp32_matmul_prec='highest',
+    )
+    optimizer = TensorParallelMuon([param], **kwargs)
+    restored = None
+    for iteration in range(4):
+        grad = torch.randn(param.shape, generator=generator)
+        grad[: splits[0]].zero_()
+        before = param.detach().clone()
+        param.grad = grad.clone()
+        optimizer.step()
+        decayed = before.clone().add_(before, alpha=-kwargs['lr'] * kwargs['weight_decay'])
+        update = (decayed - param) / kwargs['lr']
+        heads = update.split(splits)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(heads[0], torch.zeros_like(heads[0]), atol=0, rtol=0)
+        for head in heads[1:]:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                head.double().square().mean().sqrt(),
+                torch.tensor(0.18, dtype=torch.float64),
+                atol=2e-6,
+                rtol=1e-5,
+            )
+        if restored is not None:
+            restored_param.grad = grad.clone()
+            restored.step()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(restored_param, param, atol=0, rtol=0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                restored.state[restored_param]['momentum_buffer'],
+                optimizer.state[param]['momentum_buffer'],
+                atol=0,
+                rtol=0,
+            )
+        if iteration == 1:
+            restored_param = nn.Parameter(param.detach().clone())
+            restored_param.qkv_split_shapes_global = splits
+            restored = TensorParallelMuon([restored_param], **kwargs)
+            restored.load_state_dict(copy.deepcopy(optimizer.state_dict()))
+            assert set(optimizer.state[param]) == {'momentum_buffer'}

+    if recipe == "blockwise":
+        try:
+            from transformer_engine.common.recipe import Float8BlockScaling
+            from transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor.float8_blockwise_tensor import (
+                Float8BlockwiseQTensor,
+            )
+        except ImportError as exc:

+def assert_param_storage_policy(ddp, args):
+    """Check actual allocations and optimizer routing, independently of forward numerics."""
+    counts = {"muon_fp8": 0, "adam_blockwise": 0, "high_precision": 0}
+    compact_layerwise = (
+        args.use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer and not args.use_layer_wise_param_layout
+    )
+    for buffer in ddp.buffers + ddp.expert_parallel_buffers:
+        for bucket in buffer.buckets:
+            owners = {
+                getattr(p, "is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer", False) for p in bucket.params
+            }
+            assert len(owners) == 1, "A bucket must not mix optimizer ownership"
+            owner = owners.pop()
+            assert buffer.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer is not (compact_layerwise and owner)
+            reused = [
+                p
+                for p in bucket.params
+                if fp8_utils.uses_grad_buffer_for_fp8_param_gather(p, ddp.ddp_config)
+            ]
+            assert bucket.reuse_grad_buffer_for_param_ag == bool(reused)
+            grad_ptr = bucket.grad_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+            if reused and bucket.param_data is not None:
+                assert bucket.param_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr() == grad_ptr
+            for param in bucket.params:
+                if fp8_utils.is_float8tensor(
+                    param
+                ) or fp8_utils.is_grouped_tensor_with_quantized_storage(param):
+                    if owner:
+                        counts["muon_fp8"] += 1
+                    if (
+                        fp8_utils.is_blockwise_float8tensor(param)
+                        and not owner
+                        and buffer.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer
+                    ):
+                        counts["adam_blockwise"] += 1
+                        assert not bucket.reuse_grad_buffer_for_param_ag
+                        assert buffer.param_dtype == torch.uint8
+                        assert (
+                            bucket.param_data is not None and bucket.param_data.dtype == torch.uint8
+                        )
+                        assert bucket.param_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr() != grad_ptr
+                    payloads = [
+                        getattr(holder, attr, None)
+                        for holder in (param, param.data)
+                        for attr in (
+                            "_data",
+                            "_rowwise_data",
+                            "_columnwise_data",
+                            "rowwise_data",
+                            "columnwise_data",
+                        )
+                    ]
+                    payloads = [value for value in payloads if torch.is_tensor(value)]
+                    assert payloads, "Quantized storage was not exercised"
+                    assert all(value.untyped_storage().data_ptr() != grad_ptr for value in payloads)
+                else:
+                    counts["high_precision"] += 1
+                    assert not fp8_utils.uses_grad_buffer_for_fp8_param_gather(
+                        param, ddp.ddp_config
+                    )
+                    assert param.data.untyped_storage().data_ptr() != grad_ptr
+                    if buffer.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer:
+                        assert bucket.param_data is not None
+                        assert (
+                            param.data.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                            == bucket.param_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                        )
+                    elif not reused:
+                        assert bucket.param_data is None
+    assert counts[
+        "high_precision"
+    ], "Expected embeddings/norms with persistent high-precision storage"
+    return counts
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("completion", ["sync", "wait", "force"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dp_size", [1, 2, 3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("has_fp8", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mixed_dtypes", [False, True])
+def test_compact_transport_lifecycle(monkeypatch, completion, dp_size, has_fp8, mixed_dtypes):
+    """Publish repeated updates with mixed dtypes, empty ranks and each completion route."""
+    from megatron.core.distributed import param_and_grad_buffer as buffers
+
+    dtypes = [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32] if mixed_dtypes else [torch.bfloat16]
+    # The third rank deliberately owns no parameters in this bucket.
+    owner_count = min(dp_size, 2)
+    high_precision_by_rank = [
+        [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([2.0 + rank, 4.0], dtype=dtype)) for dtype in dtypes]
+        for rank in range(owner_count)
+    ]
+    high_precision = [param for params in high_precision_by_rank for param in params]
+    quantized = [
+        torch.nn.Parameter(torch.full((2,), -99.0, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+        for _ in range(owner_count)
+    ]
+    for param in quantized:
+        param.test_fp8 = True
+    # The source must be the master rather than the deliberately stale forward weight.
+    quantized[0].main_param = torch.tensor([1.006, 2.02], dtype=torch.float32)
+    expected_remote = torch.tensor([11.0625, 13.5], dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    owner_lists = [
+        high_precision_by_rank[rank] + ([quantized[rank]] if has_fp8 else [])
+        for rank in range(owner_count)
+    ] + [[] for _ in range(dp_size - owner_count)]
+    params_list = [param for params in owner_lists for param in params]
+    param_index_map = {}
+    offset = 0
+    for param in params_list:
+        param_index_map[param] = (offset, offset + param.numel(), 0)
+        offset += param.numel()
+    grad_data = torch.full((offset,), 17.0, dtype=torch.float32)
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        overlap_param_gather=completion != "sync", use_distributed_optimizer=False
+    )
+    bucket = buffers._ParamAndGradBucket(
+        params=params_list,
+        param_data=None,
+        grad_data=grad_data,
+        offset=0,
+        numel_unpadded=offset,
+        gradient_scaling_factor=1.0,
+        bucket_id=0,
+        param_index_map=param_index_map,
+        params_with_extra_main_grads=[],
+        ddp_config=config,
+        reuse_grad_buffer_for_param_ag=has_fp8,
+    )
+    group = buffers._ParamAndGradBucketGroup.__new__(buffers._ParamAndGradBucketGroup)
+    group.ddp_config = config
+    group.buckets = [bucket]
+    group.param_sync_via_bucket_group = True
+    group.param_gather_handle = None
+    group.param_gather_dispatched = False
+    group.next_param_gather_bucket_group = None
+    group.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_size = dp_size
+    group.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_rank = 0
+    group.intra_distributed_optimizer_instance_group = object()
+    reuse_policy = Mock(side_effect=lambda p, config: getattr(p, "test_fp8", False))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "uses_grad_buffer_for_fp8_param_gather", reuse_policy)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        buffers, "_param_uses_quantized_storage", lambda p: getattr(p, "test_fp8", False)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "post_all_gather_processing", Mock())
+    bucket.set_layerwise_params_list(owner_lists)
+
+    def copy_back(params, values):
+        for param, value in zip(params, values):
+            param.data.copy_(value)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "copy_back_gathered_bf16_into_fp8_params", copy_back)
+    work = Mock()
+
+    def gather(outputs, source, **kwargs):
+        for rank, output in enumerate(outputs[1:], start=1):
+            if rank >= owner_count:
+                assert output.numel() == 0
+            elif source.untyped_storage().data_ptr() == grad_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr():
+                output.copy_(expected_remote)
+            else:
+                remote = next(p for p in high_precision_by_rank[rank] if p.dtype == source.dtype)
+                output.copy_(remote.detach())
+        return work if kwargs["async_op"] else None
+
+    collective = Mock(side_effect=gather)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_gather", collective)
+    before_high_precision = [p.detach().clone() for p in high_precision]
+    for step in range(2):
+        if step:
+            # Parameter values change; owner lists, dtype groups and receive sizes do not.
+            quantized[0].main_param.add_(0.5)
+            grad_data.fill_(17.0)
+            collective.reset_mock()
+        group.start_param_sync()
+        if completion != "sync":
+            assert (
+                group.param_gather_handle is not None
+            ), "DP1 still needs local copy-back completion"
+            for _, received, reuse in bucket.layerwise_gather_list:
+                assert (
+                    received[0].untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                    == grad_data.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                ) == reuse
+            if completion == "force":
+                group.start_param_sync(force_sync=True)
+            else:
+                group.finish_param_sync(skip_next_bucket_dispatch=True)
+        assert collective.call_count == (len(dtypes) + has_fp8 if dp_size > 1 else 0)
+        assert bucket.layerwise_gather_list is None
+        assert group.param_gather_handle is None
+        for param, before in zip(high_precision, before_high_precision):
+            assert torch.equal(param, before)
+        if has_fp8:
+            assert torch.equal(quantized[0], quantized[0].main_param.to(torch.bfloat16))
+            if dp_size > 1:
+                assert torch.equal(quantized[1], expected_remote)
+            assert torch.count_nonzero(grad_data) == 0
+        else:
+            assert torch.all(grad_data == 17), "High-precision AG must not touch gradient storage"
+

+def test_nested_optimizer_staging_and_deferred_gather(native_sibling):
+    """Shared-chunk sync waits for reused and native Adam leaves to update."""
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.distrib_optimizer import DistributedOptimizer
+    from megatron.core.optimizer.optimizer import ChainedOptimizer
+
+    events = []
+    group = SimpleNamespace(
+        buckets=[
+            SimpleNamespace(params_list=[SimpleNamespace(is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer=False)])
+        ]
+    )
+    model = SimpleNamespace(
+        bucket_groups=[group],
+        expert_parallel_bucket_groups=[],
+        finish_pending_param_sync=lambda: events.append("finish"),
+        zero_grad_buffer=lambda: events.append("zero"),
+        _start_bucket_group_param_sync=lambda *args, **kwargs: events.append("gather"),
+    )
+    config = SimpleNamespace(overlap_param_gather_with_optimizer_step=False, timers=None)
+    leaves = []
+    for index, reuse in enumerate((True, not native_sibling)):
+        leaf = DistributedOptimizer.__new__(DistributedOptimizer)
+        leaf.is_stub_optimizer = False
+        leaf.reuse_grad_buffer_for_param_ag = reuse
+        leaf.ddp_config = SimpleNamespace(overlap_param_gather=False)
+        leaf.model_chunks = [model]
+        leaf._copy_main_params_to_param_buffer = lambda index=index: events.append(f"stage{index}")
+        leaves.append(leaf)
+
+    def step(index):
+        assert all(leaf._defer_param_sync for leaf in leaves)
+        events.append(f"step{index}")
+        return True
+
+    for index, leaf in enumerate(leaves):
+        leaf.step_with_ready_grads = lambda index=index: step(index)
+    inner = ChainedOptimizer.__new__(ChainedOptimizer)
+    inner.chained_optimizers = [leaves[0]]
+    inner.config = config
+    outer = ChainedOptimizer.__new__(ChainedOptimizer)
+    outer.chained_optimizers = [inner, leaves[1]]
+    outer.config = config
+    outer.prepare_model_params_for_param_sync()
+    assert events == ["finish", "zero", "stage0"] + ([] if native_sibling else ["stage1"])
+    events.clear()
+    assert outer.step_with_ready_grads()
+    assert events == ["step0", "step1", "gather"]
+    assert not any(leaf._defer_param_sync for leaf in leaves)
+    # A raw configuration opt-in alone must not activate staging/deferral.
+    for leaf in leaves:
+        leaf.reuse_grad_buffer_for_param_ag = False
+        leaf.ddp_config.reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag = True
+    assert not outer._should_defer_mxfp8_param_sync()

+
+def _is_quantized(p):
+    # NB: do not probe for a ``dequantize`` attribute -- ``torch.Tensor.dequantize`` is defined
+    # for every tensor (it returns ``self.to(float32)`` for dense ones), so ``hasattr`` is always
+    # True and would classify plain bf16 params as quantized.
+    return is_float8tensor(p) or is_float8tensor(p.data)
+
+
+def _assert_equal(actual, expected, msg):
+    if torch.equal(actual, expected):
+        return
+    diff = (actual.float() - expected.float()).abs()
+    raise AssertionError(
+        f"{msg}: max_diff={diff.max().item()} dtype={actual.dtype}/{expected.dtype}"
+    )
+
+
+def _snapshot_masters(model, optimizer):
+    # FP8 storage grouping can change whole-matrix ownership, so reconstruct
+    # each Muon master by name rather than comparing rank-local owner sets.
+    layerwise = optimizer.chained_optimizers[0]
+    local_layerwise_masters = {}
+    for child in layerwise.chained_optimizers:
+        for model_group, main_group in zip(child.float16_groups, child.fp32_from_float16_groups):
+            local_layerwise_masters.update(zip(model_group, main_group))
+        for model_group in child.fp32_from_fp32_groups:
+            local_layerwise_masters.update((param, param) for param in model_group)
+    param_buffers = {
+        p: buffer for buffer in model.buffers + model.expert_parallel_buffers for p in buffer.params
+    }
+    result = {}
+    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
+        main = getattr(param, "main_param", None)
+        if getattr(param, "is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer", False):
+            main = local_layerwise_masters.get(param)
+            value = torch.zeros(param.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=param.device)
+            owner_count = torch.tensor(int(main is not None), device=param.device)
+            if main is not None:
+                value.copy_(main.detach())
+            group = param_buffers[param].data_parallel_group
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(value, group=group)
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(owner_count, group=group)
+            assert owner_count.item() == 1, f"Expected one LayerWise owner for {name}"
+            result[name] = value
+        elif main is not None:
+            result[name] = main.detach().clone()
+    return result
+
+
+def _snapshot_grads(model):
+    param_buffers = {
+        p: buffer for buffer in model.buffers + model.expert_parallel_buffers for p in buffer.params
+    }
+    result = {}
+    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
+        if param.main_grad is None:
+            continue
+        value = param.main_grad.detach().clone()
+        buffer = param_buffers[param]
+        if (
+            getattr(param, "is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer", False)
+            and buffer.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer
+        ):
+            # Reduce-scatter publishes a complete Muon matrix only on its owner.
+            if getattr(param, "main_param", None) is None:
+                value.zero_()
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(value, group=buffer.data_parallel_group)
+        result[name] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def _snapshot_params(model):
+    """Compare persistent high-precision weights for gather ON/OFF.
+
+    Quantized weights have different storage in the two modes; their FP32 masters
+    and reduced gradients are compared separately.
+    """
+    result = {
+        name: param.detach().clone()
+        for name, param in model.named_parameters()
+        if not _is_quantized(param)
+    }
+    assert result, "Expected high-precision parameters to compare"
+    return result
+
+
+def _snapshot_layerwise_grad_data(ddp):
+    # Compact buffers can contain high-precision-only buckets alongside FP8 buckets.
+    # Finalization clears only buckets whose gradients supplied FP8 gather storage.
+    return [
+        bucket.grad_data.detach().clone()
+        for buf in (ddp.buffers + ddp.expert_parallel_buffers)
+        if not buf.ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer
+        for bucket in buf.buckets
+        if bucket.reuse_grad_buffer_for_param_ag
+    ]
+
+
+class TestMuonFP8ParamGather:
+
+    def setup_method(self, method):
+        self.seq_length = 128
+        self.micro_batch_size = 1
+        os.environ['CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS'] = '1'
+        # InferenceMode is a process-global (class-level) flag. Another test file
+        # in the same pytest shard can leave it active (e.g. an inference engine
+        # test that aborts before unset). These are training tests, so the GPT
+        # postprocess "Inference must always gather TP logits" assertion would
+        # then fire spuriously. Force training mode before each test.
+        InferenceMode.unset_active()
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=1,
+            pipeline_model_parallel_size=1,
+            expert_model_parallel_size=1,

+    def teardown_method(self, method):

+
+    def model_provider(self, pre_process=True, post_process=True, **kw):
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(_SEED)
+        args = get_args()
+        return GPTModel(
+            config=core_transformer_config_from_args(args),
+            transformer_layer_spec=get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec(
+                num_experts=args.num_experts, moe_grouped_gemm=args.moe_grouped_gemm
+            ),
+            vocab_size=args.padded_vocab_size,
+            max_sequence_length=args.max_position_embeddings,
+            pre_process=pre_process,
+            post_process=post_process,
+            share_embeddings_and_output_weights=not args.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights,
+            position_embedding_type=args.position_embedding_type,
+        )
+
+    def _create_args(
+        self, fp8_param_gather, fp8_recipe, overlap, num_experts=0, expert_model_parallel_size=1
+    ):
+        destroy_global_vars()
+        destroy_num_microbatches_calculator()
+        sys.argv = ['test_muon_fp8_param_gather.py']
+        args = parse_args()
+        args.num_layers = 2
+        args.padded_vocab_size = 256
+        args.hidden_size = 128
+        args.ffn_hidden_size = 256
+        args.num_attention_heads = 4
+        args.max_position_embeddings = self.seq_length
+        args.seq_length = self.seq_length
+        args.micro_batch_size = self.micro_batch_size
+        args.create_attention_mask_in_dataloader = True
+        args.tensor_model_parallel_size = 1
+        args.pipeline_model_parallel_size = 1
+        args.context_parallel_size = 1
+        args.expert_model_parallel_size = expert_model_parallel_size
+        args.train_iters = 10
+        # Larger lr than a real run: amplifies any fp8-path discrepancy so an ON-vs-OFF
+        # mismatch (if one exists) shows up within a handful of steps rather than being
+        # lost in the low bits (per PR #5470 review). The model is tiny so this stays stable.
+        args.lr = 1e-3
+        args.clip_grad = 0.0
+        args.bf16 = True
+        args.add_bias_linear = False
+        args.swiglu = True
+        args.hidden_dropout = 0.0
+        args.attention_dropout = 0.0
+        args.attention_backend = "unfused"
+        # muon + use_distributed_optimizer auto-routes to LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer.
+        args.optimizer = 'muon'
+        args.muon_momentum = 0.9
+        args.muon_scale_mode = 'spectral'
+        args.muon_num_ns_steps = 5
+        args.muon_coefficient_type = 'quintic'
+        args.muon_tp_mode = 'duplicated'
+        args.use_precision_aware_optimizer = False
+        args.exp_avg_dtype = 'fp32'
+        args.exp_avg_sq_dtype = 'fp32'
+        args.use_distributed_optimizer = True
+        args.use_layer_wise_param_layout = self.use_param_layout
+        # --overlap-param-gather requires --overlap-grad-reduce (arguments.py); co-enable.
+        args.overlap_param_gather = overlap
+        args.overlap_grad_reduce = overlap
+        args.fp8 = "e4m3"
+        args.fp8_recipe = fp8_recipe
+        args.fp8_param_gather = fp8_param_gather
+        if fp8_param_gather and fp8_recipe == "mxfp8":
+            args.reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag = (
+                True  # mxfp8 columnwise needs the bf16 round-trip
+            )
+        if num_experts > 0:
+            # Expert matrices use LayerWise/Muon. Expert-DP1 stages and publishes
+            # local FP8 parameters through DDP without a collective; larger groups
+            # additionally gather the staged parameters from their owners.
+            args.num_experts = num_experts
+            args.moe_router_topk = 2
+            args.moe_ffn_hidden_size = args.ffn_hidden_size
+            args.moe_token_dispatcher_type = 'alltoall'
+            args.moe_grouped_gemm = False
+            # Deterministic routing comes from the fixed seed + deterministic_mode; drop the
+            # aux-loss gradient term so ON and OFF compare cleanly without router-bias drift.
+            args.moe_router_load_balancing_type = 'none'
+            args.moe_aux_loss_coeff = 0.0
+        args.ddp_bucket_size = 1024  # more buckets -> exercise rs/ag overlap
+        validate_args(args)
+        set_args(args)
+        set_run_config(pretrain_cfg_container_from_args(args))
+        initialize_runtime_services(args, build_tokenizer=False, training=True)
+        return args
+
+    def _batch(self):
+        d = list(range(self.seq_length))
+        ids = torch.tensor(d, dtype=torch.int64).repeat((self.micro_batch_size, 1)).cuda()
+        labels = 1 + ids
+        pos = ids.clone()
+        mask = torch.ones(
+            (self.micro_batch_size, 1, self.seq_length, self.seq_length), dtype=bool
+        ).cuda()
+        loss_mask = torch.ones(self.seq_length).repeat((self.micro_batch_size, 1)).cuda()
+        return ids, labels, pos, mask, loss_mask
+
+    def _build(
+        self, fp8_param_gather, fp8_recipe, overlap, num_experts=0, expert_model_parallel_size=1
+    ):
+        args = self._create_args(
+            fp8_param_gather,
+            fp8_recipe,
+            overlap,
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            expert_model_parallel_size=expert_model_parallel_size,
+        )
+        set_args(args)
+        torch.manual_seed(_SEED)
+        # The config builder bypasses model_provider, so reset its CUDA RNG tracker
+        # here as well. torch.manual_seed does not reset Megatron's tracked streams.
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(
+            _SEED,
+            te_rng_tracker=args.te_rng_tracker,
+            use_cudagraphable_rng=args.cuda_graph_impl != "none",
+            force_reset_rng=True,
+        )
+        model, optimizer, _ = setup_model_and_optimizer(
+            ModelType.encoder_or_decoder,
+            self.model_provider,
+            cfg_container=Utils.pretrain_config_from_global_args(args, "gpt"),
+            pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups(),
+        )
+        assert len(model) == 1
+        assert len(optimizer.chained_optimizers) == 2
+        assert isinstance(optimizer.chained_optimizers[0], LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)
+        counts = assert_param_storage_policy(model[0], args)
+        if fp8_param_gather:
+            assert counts["muon_fp8"], "No native Muon FP8 parameters were exercised"
+        return args, model, optimizer
+
+    def _run_steps(self, args, model, optimizer, n):
+        """Run ``n`` deterministic steps; return per-step loss, forward output,
+        per-param ``main_grad`` (pre-step), fp32 master (post-step), and forward-time params."""
+        # Each trajectory runs under the globals initialized by its own _build.
+        assert get_args() is args
+        ids, labels, pos, mask, loss_mask = self._batch()
+        losses, outs, grads, masters, params = [], [], [], [], []
+        for _ in range(n):
+            model[0].zero_grad_buffer()
+            optimizer.zero_grad()
+            # Restage reused FP8 transport after gradient reset, as production does
+            # before a deferred gather. High-precision parameters keep separate storage.
+            if args.overlap_param_gather:
+                optimizer.prepare_model_params_for_param_sync()
+            if args.overlap_param_gather:
+                # The deferred gather must still be pending here. A forced sync that forgets to
+                # re-arm leaves param_gather_dispatched=True and turns the forward pre-hook into
+                # a silent no-op -- the test would keep passing while losing the overlap
+                # coverage it exists for.
+                # ``all``, not ``any``: with ``any`` a single armed dense group would mask a
+                # refactor that drops expert_parallel_bucket_groups from the reset, leaving
+                # every expert group permanently dispatched. ``_groups and`` because all([])
+                # is vacuously True.
+                _groups = model[0].bucket_groups + model[0].expert_parallel_bucket_groups
+                assert _groups and all(not g.param_gather_dispatched for g in _groups), (
+                    "forward pre-hook is not armed for every bucket group: the deferred param "
+                    "all-gather would be skipped, so this iteration does not exercise the "
+                    "overlap path"
+                )
+            model[0].set_is_first_microbatch()
+            out = model[0].forward(
+                input_ids=ids,
+                position_ids=pos,
+                attention_mask=mask,
+                labels=labels,
+                loss_mask=loss_mask,
+            )
+            # Observe the weights consumed by this forward. Do not publish updated
+            # weights between steps: the next forward pre-hook must complete the gather.
+            # Native FP8 storage is compared through outputs, gradients and masters;
+            # dequantized FP8 values need not equal the gather-OFF BF16 parameters.
+            params.append(_snapshot_params(model[0]))
+            loss = out.mean()
+            loss.backward()
+            model[0].finish_grad_sync()
+            grad = _snapshot_grads(model[0])
+            ok, _, _ = optimizer.step()
+            assert ok
+            masters.append(_snapshot_masters(model[0], optimizer))
+            grads.append(grad)
+            losses.append(loss.detach().clone())
+            outs.append(out.detach().clone())
+        return losses, outs, grads, masters, params
+
+    def _check_on_vs_off(self, fp8_recipe, overlap, n, num_experts=0, expert_model_parallel_size=1):
+        """fp8_param_gather ON must match OFF bitwise for ``n`` deterministic steps on
+        per-step loss / forward output / per-param main_grad / fp32 master / bf16 param."""
+        with deterministic_mode():
+            off_args, off_model, off_opt = self._build(
+                False, fp8_recipe, overlap, num_experts, expert_model_parallel_size
+            )
+            masters0 = _snapshot_masters(off_model[0], off_opt)
+            off = self._run_steps(off_args, off_model, off_opt, n)
+            del off_model, off_opt
+            gc.collect()
+            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+
+            # Run each trajectory with its own initialized runtime services instead
+            # of rebinding the process-global run config between optimizer steps.
+            on_args, on_model, on_opt = self._build(
+                True, fp8_recipe, overlap, num_experts, expert_model_parallel_size
+            )
+            # Compare independently initialized native masters. Copying the OFF state into
+            # ON here would conceal a regression that seeds masters from lossy FP8 values.
+            on_masters0 = _snapshot_masters(on_model[0], on_opt)
+            assert masters0.keys() == on_masters0.keys()
+            assert masters0, "No FP32 master parameters captured"
+            for name in masters0:
+                _assert_equal(on_masters0[name], masters0[name], f"native initialization {name}")
+
+            on = self._run_steps(on_args, on_model, on_opt, n)
+            del on_model, on_opt
+            gc.collect()
+            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+
+        lo, oo, go, mo, po = off
+        ln, on_, gn, mn, pn = on
+        for s in range(n):
+            _assert_equal(ln[s], lo[s], f"loss step {s}")
+            _assert_equal(on_[s], oo[s], f"output step {s}")
+            assert gn[s].keys() == go[s].keys(), f"grad param set mismatch step {s}"
+            for k in gn[s]:
+                _assert_equal(gn[s][k], go[s][k], f"grad step {s} {k}")
+            # ON stores the fp8 weights as Float8/MXFP8 and skips them; OFF keeps the same
+            # weights as plain bf16, so ON's key set is a subset. What survives -- layernorms,
+            # biases, embeddings, the output layer -- are real bf16 param tensors compared
+            # bitwise. The fp8 weights are covered by the master + reduced-grad checks above.
+            assert pn[s].keys() <= po[s].keys(), f"param set mismatch step {s}"
+            assert pn[s], f"no comparable params captured step {s}"
+            # Pin the skipped (fp8-on-ON-only) set: a bare subset assert would silently accept
+            # a param dropping out of the comparison, e.g. if a copy-back regression replaced
+            # a bf16 ``param.data`` with quantized storage on the ON side only.
+            _dropped = po[s].keys() - pn[s].keys()
+            if s == 0:
+                _dropped_0 = _dropped
+                assert _dropped, "no fp8 params skipped -- the ON run is not using fp8 storage"
+            assert _dropped == _dropped_0, f"fp8-skipped param set changed at step {s}"
+            for k in pn[s]:
+                _assert_equal(pn[s][k], po[s][k], f"param step {s} {k}")
+            assert mn[s].keys() == mo[s].keys(), f"master param set mismatch step {s}"
+            assert mn[s], f"no masters captured step {s}"
+            common = mn[s].keys()
+            for k in common:
+                _assert_equal(mn[s][k], mo[s][k], f"master step {s} {k}")
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("overlap", [False, True])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("fp8_recipe", ["blockwise", "mxfp8"])

+            self.is_first_microbatch = True
+            self.weight.main_grad = torch.zeros_like(self.weight)
+
+        def forward(self, x):

+            self.is_first_microbatch = False
